artifacts.summary: Verifies 18/18 local plan coverage and exact grammar of 'Files to modify', confirms an existing reusable --file-scope-add union-merge mechanism in update-task-status.sh, identifies three (not one) postflight-plan call sites needing the harvest wired in, and resolves the dispatch's three open decisions (union merge, revision re-harvest, non-fatal failure).

memory_candidates.content: When a task asks to 'wire X into plan postflight', check for ALL call sites of `update-task-status.sh postflight <N> plan <session>`, not just the obvious orchestrator-postflight.sh one. In this codebase there are three: orchestrator-postflight.sh Stage 7, reconcile-task-status.sh (two call sites, self-healing status reconciliation), and skill-reviser/SKILL.md Stage 7 (/revise path). A plan or implementation that only touches the first will silently miss plan revisions and reconciliation-driven promotions.

update-task-status.sh already has a reusable additive union-merge mechanism for state.json's file_scope field: --file-scope-add=<json-array>, routed through the single mutex-guarded state-write.sh writer, currently restricted to operation=postflight && target_status=research. Any new task needing to merge more paths into file_scope at a different postflight point should widen this flag's restriction rather than hand-rolling a new jq read-modify-write or a parallel merge mechanism.
